title: Former Ole Miss DL Zxavian Harris to enter NCAA Transfer Portal

sources.title: Former Ole Miss DL Zxavian Harris to enter NCAA Transfer Portal
sources.description: Zxavian Harris, a defensive lineman who played for Ole Miss, is expected to enter the NCAA Transfer Portal, according to Matt Zeintz of CBS Sports.
